trial_court: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate No.2, Udaipur, Regular Criminal Case No.89/2011

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Rajasthan and Ms. Reecha Mogra, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married on 13.02.2005. FIR was registered on 25.08.2010. Disputes were resolved by an agreement dated 12.04.2012.

legal_principles.principle: A party who obtains relief without contest cannot later challenge the same on grounds of coercion or threat.
legal_principles.held: We find it extremely difficult to accept this argument in the background of the fact that pursuant to the compromise deed the respondent-husband has given her a consent divorce which she wanted thus had performed his part of the obligation under the compromise deed.

legal_principles.principle: A party's partial performance of their obligations under a compromise deed can be considered as fulfilling the terms of the agreement.
legal_principles.held: Even the appellant partially performed her part of the obligations by withdrawing her criminal complaint filed under Section 125.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings pertaining to Regular Criminal Case No.89/2011 pending trial before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate No.2, Udaipur were quashed.

use_for_drafting: quashing criminal proceedings in domestic violence cases
